parts.note_add: Catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.118) lists the top ceiling as FA01-68-030C for the '81 normal roof and FA04-68-030C / FA04-68-070A for the sunroof; no '82-83 normal-roof number appears on the page. The 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-13) removes it after the mirror, sun visors, seaming welts, front pillar trims, rear center trims, seat belt anchor bolts, rear quarter trims and the upper weatherstrip, then the listing wires; it is refitted warmed to 30-50 C, listing wires in from the centre outwards, rear end onto the body flange, front end into the body's inserting point, sides glued to the body flange over double-sided tape. Owners report the board is vacuum-formed fibreboard recovered with foam-backed cloth and spray adhesive (rx7club). Newstalgia sells a 1978-85 RX7 headliner fabric kit, F526 solid roof (front-to-back bows) or F561 factory sunroof, USD 269.95, bows reused - check the roof type first.

LRB Speed's aluminium hatch bulkhead panel fits '81-85 only and is offered with the stock hatch (cargo) light cut-out or blank, matching the catalogue's with/without-cargo-lamp variants - check the lamp before ordering either. No separate pad is sold; the reproduction molded carpet kits carry their own jute pad heat-bonded to the carpet (Stock Interiors 8162 complete kit USD 278.95, passenger area padded, cargo area not; ACC cargo carpet via Raybuck from USD 146.76 with optional mass backing). Catalogue S-005 Body-Index p.125 lists the front pad FA01-68-651A and rear pad 1480-68-654A beside the front mat FA01-68-671B.

See PT941: the reproduction carpet's bonded jute pad replaces it; no separate rear pad found. The catalogue (S-005 Body-Index p.125) lists the rear mat in small and large types by serial and model year; the pad 1480-68-654A is one for all.
Catalogue S-005 Body-Index p.126 gives the floor silencer 0208-76-071 as 30 cm x 30 cm, one per car; where it sits on the floor is not stated - check when the carpet is up.
